sources.summary: Human Rights Watch (29 October 2025): a leaked draft judicial-reform package (the 11th Judicial Reform) would pave the way for criminal charges against LGBT people, described as one of the most alarming rights rollbacks in decades; activists held a press conference in Istanbul on 28 October 2025 against the provisions targeting LGBT people.

Kaos GL Association's LGBTI+ Human Rights Report 2025, titled 'The Year of the Family: A Major Siege Against LGBTI+ People': in 2025 anti-LGBTI policies became institutionalised, hate speech spread from senior officials, and instructions issued to public institutions under the 'Year of the Family' banner (with religious and administrative rhetoric) created a hostile climate.

NOTE: cached page returned navigation-only content; the article is bianet (31 July 2025) 'İstanbul police detain trans women for ID checks amid profiling concerns'. The full account is documented in the country dossier: around 20 trans women rounded up in Beyoğlu during ordinary activity and taken to a Taksim police station for 'GBT' identity checks, held about two hours, names recorded and videos filmed; one detainee called it profiling.
